nodes.name: 🔔 GitHub Push Webhook (optional)
nodes.notes: Configure this URL in GitHub repo Settings > Webhooks. Trigger on: push, pull_request, issues.

nodes.name: 🐍 git_extractor.py
nodes.notes: Runs git_extractor.py. Output (stdout) is the structured snapshot text sent to the AI agent. Errors go to stderr and are captured by the Error Handler.

nodes.name: 📂 Load Current PMBOK Artifacts
nodes.notes: Reads the current risk register so the agent can check for existing risks and increment IDs correctly.

nodes.name: 📂 Load System Prompt
nodes.notes: Loads the system prompt from disk so it can be versioned in Git independently of the n8n workflow.

nodes.name: ✅ Validate Risk Schema
nodes.notes: Dry-run validates the JSON payload against PMBOK schema before writing anything.

parameters.command: echo '{{ JSON.stringify($('🔍 Parse Agent Output').item.json) }}' | python /home/node/src/kanban_connector.py --provider {{ $('⚙️ Set Config').item.json.kanban_provider }} --stdin
